FoodCodeText: Keep a log to record employee illness symptoms. Have it available upon request.
InspectorComments: No employee illness log onsite at the time of the inspection. An electronic version will be sent along with the report. Print and use it as necessary.

FoodCodeText: Throw away TCS foods seven days after being made or opened. Day one is the date food was made or opened.
InspectorComments: Jalapeno vinaigrette (6/27) and hot sauce (5/30) inside the 2-door upright stand refrigerator made in house and not used or discarded within 7 days. Use or discard food within 7 days.

FoodCodeText: Keep all cold TCS foods at 41 degrees F or colder under mechanical refrigeration.
InspectorComments: Tomato (43*F), pickled pickles (42*F), and raw meat (45*F) inside the cold station 2 observed reading higher than 41*F at the time of the inspection. Maintain all cold food at 41*F or below at all times. The person in charge has been informed to adjust the unit dial and recheck the cold station after an hour.

FoodCodeText: Have a test kit for the type of sanitizer used.
InspectorComments: Person in charge could not locate the chlorine and quat test strips to test quat sanitizer buckets and chlorine dish machine. Obtain.

FoodCodeText: Keep all cold TCS foods at 41 degrees F or colder under mechanical refrigeration.
InspectorComments: Tomato (47*F) and pickles (50*F) inside the cold station 2 observed reading above 41*F at the time of the inspection. Maintain food temperature at 41*F or below at all times. Discussed methods of maintaining food temperature with the person in charge.

FoodCodeText: Keep all cold TCS foods at 41 degrees F or colder under mechanical refrigeration.
InspectorComments: Observed coleslaw (45*F) and sliced sandwich meat (47*F) inside the topless cold station reading higher than 41*F. Maintain cold food at 41°F or below. Adjust the unit dial as needed and avoid overfilling food containers within the cold station.

FoodCodeText: Keep a log to record employee illness symptoms. Have it available upon request.
InspectorComments: Observed no illness log at the time of the inspection. Provide.

FoodCodeText: Store food preparation or dispensing utensils that are used with non-TCS foods, such as ice, in a clean, protected location.
InspectorComments: Observed ice scoop handle coming into contact with ice inside the ice machine. Store ice scoop with handle away from food.

FoodCodeText: Store in-use food preparation and serving utensils only on clean, sanitized surfaces.
InspectorComments: Observed tong hanging on stove handle - remove and discontinue this practice.

FoodCodeText: Food employees must use a closed beverage container within the food preparation or utensil washing areas.
InspectorComments: Observed employee unapproved beverage in the prep line area. Discontinue drinking from an unapproved beverage container. Provide approved container.

FoodCodeText: Keep the plumbing system in good repair.
InspectorComments: Observed mop sink in the basement missing drain cover. Provide and secure drain cover to mop sink.
